geo-period.q: A satellite orbits 35786 km above the equator. How long is one orbit, in hours?
geo-period.reply: NEED: What is the mass of the Earth (in kg) or its gravitational parameter (mu) in m^3/s^2?
geo-period.first:
=PLANET("Earth","radius")
ANS: 6371000
=CONVERT(35786,"km","m")
ANS: 35786000
=PLANET("Earth","period")
ANS: 86164
=ORBITT(CONVERT(35786,"km","m")+6371000,PLANET("Earth","gm"))/60
ANS: 1436.06
=1436.06/60
ANS: 23.9343
ANSWER: The orbit takes 23.9343 hours.

passages: Natural gas (also gas, methane gas or fossil gas) is a fossil fuel, naturally occurring in geological formations. Because natural gas is odorless, a commercial odorizer, such as methanethiol, that smells of hydrogen sulfide (rotten eggs) is added to the gas for the ready detection of gas leaks. Natural gas is a fossil fuel that is formed when layers of organic matter (primarily marine microorganisms) are thermally decomposed under oxygen-free conditions, subjected to intense heat and pressure underground over millions of years. Most natural gas is collected from underground geological formations, often alongside other fossil fuels like coal and oil (petroleum). Natural gas is often a byproduct of petroleum production, where it can either be vented without burning, flared (burned off) or collected. make-parallel-ohm.q: Draw a parallel circuit for a lesson: a 12 V battery with 4, 6 and 12 ohm resistors in parallel, and show the total resistance on the picture.
make-parallel-ohm.reply:
MAKE SCHEMATIC: Parallel Resistors
mode electrical
part V1 battery "12 V"
part R1 resistor "4 ohm"
part R2 resistor "6 ohm"
part R3 resistor "12 ohm"
wire V1 R1
wire R1 R2
wire R2 R3
wire R3 V1
note Rt = 1 / (1/4 + 1/6 + 1/12) = {=1/(1/4+1/6+1/12)} ohm
END
make-parallel-ohm.why: two resistors are wired to each other (series), not in parallel

chat-calc-follow-up.q: A 12 V pump draws 5 A. How many watts is that? → And how many amp-hours does it use in 3 hours?
chat-calc-follow-up.reply:
= WATTS(12,5)
= 12*5
= 60*3
ANSWER: The pump uses 180 amp-hours in 3 hours.
